Who is the best painter in North Sydney?

Sydney Paintmasters is a licensed, insured painting company serving North Sydney and the wider Lower North Shore for more than 20 years, holding Painter Decorator Licence 315254C. We paint houses, interiors, exteriors, strata blocks, offices and commercial sites, plus roofs, pools and epoxy floors. Every job starts with a free on-site quote, a fixed price, and no call-out fee. props.label: Services
props.html:
What we paint

Painting services across the Lower North Shore

One licensed crew, nine core services. From a single feature wall to a full strata repaint, here is what we take on across the LGA.

House Painting Lower North Shore

Full-home repaints inside and out, from weatherboard cottages to double-brick family homes. We prep properly so the finish lasts.

Interior Painting Lower North Shore

Walls, ceilings, cornices, doors and trim. Low-odour paints, tidy cut-ins, and floors and furniture protected every day.

Exterior Painting Lower North Shore

Facades, eaves, render, timber and fibro built to cope with harbour salt, UV and wind-driven rain. Mould-treated before we prime.

Office Painting Lower North Shore

Workspaces refreshed around your hours. We paint after-hours or in staged zones so the team keeps working through it.

Strata Painting Lower North Shore

Common areas, foyers, balconies and unit-block exteriors. We coordinate with your strata manager and committee from quote to sign-off.

Commercial Painting Lower North Shore

Shops, hospitality venues and mixed-use sites. Durable coatings, safe access, and clean handovers that meet your open-by date.

Epoxy Flooring Lower North Shore

Hard-wearing epoxy for garages, warehouses and commercial floors. Sealed, slip-rated and easy to keep clean.

Pool Painting Lower North Shore

Concrete pool repaints in the right chlorinated-rubber or epoxy system, prepped and coated to hold up under water and sun.

Roof Painting Lower North Shore

Tile and metal roof restoration: clean, repair, prime and coat. A membrane system that lifts the whole street frontage.

props.label: The Sydney Paintmasters way
props.html:
Why locals call us back

The Sydney Paintmasters way

Twenty years in one patch teaches you what matters. Here is what you get, every job.

Licensed and insured

Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and full insurance. Ask and we will show you before we start.

Fixed-price quotes

A written line-item price up front. What we quote is what you pay. No call-out fee, ever.

On time, tidy site

We show up when we say, mask and cover everything, and leave the place cleaner than we found it.

Prep that lasts

Sand, fill, treat mould, prime bare surfaces. The prep is why the coat still looks sharp years on.

You stay in the loop

One point of contact from quote to final walk-through. Questions get answered the same day.

5-star reviewed

Two decades of repeat clients and referrals across the LGA. See the latest reviews below.

props.label: Suburbs
props.html:
Where we paint

Painting suburb by suburb across the LGA

We work the whole Lower North Shore. Here is the local detail we bring to each pocket, from harbourside heritage to the apartment strips.

Painting services in Neutral Bay2089

Neutral Bay is Military Road and Neutral Bay Junction out front, interwar Art Deco walk-ups behind. We repaint those rendered facades and shared stairwells, match original heritage tones, and work around body-corporate rules. The quiet Kurraba Point peninsula just off Neutral Bay is covered too.

Get a Neutral Bay quote →

Painting services in Crows Nest2065

Around the Willoughby Road dining strip, the Holtermann Estate is packed with Victorian and Federation terraces under conservation controls. We prep aged timber carefully, honour approved colour schemes, and keep small-lot sites tidy for the neighbours.

Get a Crows Nest quote →

Painting services in St Leonards2065

St Leonards runs to towers, medical suites near Royal North Shore, and new high-rise apartments. We paint tenancies and common areas out of hours, use low-odour systems, and stage the work so a busy commercial floor keeps running.

Get a St Leonards quote →

Painting services in Cremorne2090

Cremorne mixes Spanish Mission and Art Deco apartment blocks with period houses around the Hayden Orpheum. We restore decorative render and timber windows, and colour-match to suit. The Cremorne Point peninsula, just south, is part of the same run.

Get a Cremorne quote →

Painting services in Wollstonecraft2065

Wollstonecraft is Federation homes on big leafy blocks, a proper garden-suburb feel. We paint wide eaves, fretwork and weatherboard with heritage-friendly colours, and treat shaded, damp-prone walls before a single coat goes on.

Get a Wollstonecraft quote →

Painting services in Kirribilli2061

Kirribilli packs Victorian terraces and Art Deco flats tight against the harbour, with conservation-area colour rules in play. We handle heritage approvals sensibly, work narrow access, and finish exteriors that cop full sun and salt spray.

Get a Kirribilli quote →

Painting services in Waverton2060

Waverton is a quiet peninsula of Federation and Victorian cottages near Balls Head and Berrys Bay. We repaint timber fronts and iron roofs that face weather off the water, with prep built for a coating that holds.

Get a Waverton quote →

Painting services in Cammeray2062

Cammeray sits around the Miller Street village, a mix of Federation homes, California bungalows and interwar flats. We refresh interiors and street frontages, and match the period detail that gives the suburb its character.

Get a Cammeray quote →

Painting services in McMahons Point2060

McMahons Point runs down Blues Point Road to the water, Victorian and Federation cottages the whole way. We repaint steep harbourside timber and the small conservation-area frontages here. The tucked-away Lavender Bay pocket next door is covered too.

Get a McMahons Point quote →

Painting services in Milsons Point2061

Milsons Point lives under the Harbour Bridge and beside Luna Park, mostly interwar apartment blocks. We repaint balconies, foyers and rendered facades that take hard sun off the water, and coordinate access in busy buildings.

props.label: Process
props.html:
Simple from the start

Three steps, no surprises

We keep it short. You call, we quote, we paint. Here is how a job runs.

1

Free on-site quote

We visit, listen, measure and write a fixed line-item price. No call-out fee and no pressure. You will know exactly what is included.

2

Prep and paint

We protect the site, do the unglamorous prep first, then coat with quality paint. Same crew start to finish, tidy every afternoon.

3

Walk-through and done

We walk the job with you, fix any touch-ups on the spot, and clean up fully. You sign off only when you are happy.

props.label: Specialties
props.html:
What sets us apart

Three things we are known for

The LGA is not a blank canvas. Heritage rules, dense strata, and a harbour that eats exteriors. We build for all three.

Heritage

Federation and character homes

Across North Sydney, Neutral Bay, Cremorne and Waverton, most streets sit inside a conservation area. We handle careful timber prep, period detailing and heritage-appropriate colours, so a repaint respects the home and the guidelines.

Strata

Apartments, blocks and high-rise

The LGA is one of Sydney's densest apartment areas. We paint unit blocks, foyers, balconies and high-rise common property, coordinating with strata managers and committees so the whole building lands on one clear scope.

Coastal

Harbourside weather protection

Homes facing the water cop salt air, strong UV, wind-driven rain and shaded damp. We treat mould, seal bare surfaces and choose coating systems built to hold on timber, render, masonry and metal for the long haul.

props.label: Faq General
props.html:
Booking, quotes and cover

Common questions before you book

The practical stuff people ask us most: how to book, what a quote costs, and how we are covered.

How do I book a painter on the Lower North Shore?
Call 0423 019 087 or send the quote form on this page. We arrange a free on-site visit, usually the same week, then give you a written fixed price. Once you accept, we lock in a start date that suits you.
Is your quote really free with no call-out fee?
Yes. The on-site visit and the written quote are free, and there is no call-out fee at any stage. You only pay once you have accepted a fixed price and the work is booked in.
Are you licensed and insured?
We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and carry full insurance. We are happy to show both before we start. Public liability cover can be confirmed on request for strata and commercial jobs.
Do you give a fixed price or an hourly rate?
Fixed price. Your quote is a written, line-item scope, so the number you accept is the number you pay. If you later add work, we price that separately and get your okay first.
What paint brands do you use?
We use premium trade lines from the major Australian brands, matched to the surface and exposure. For harbourside exteriors we lean on proven weather-shield systems. Have a preferred brand or colour? Tell us and we will work to it.
How long does a typical repaint take?
A single interior room is often a day. A full home interior usually runs several days, and a house exterior depends on size, access and prep. We give you a realistic timeline in the quote, not a guess on the phone.
How quickly will you reply to my enquiry?
We reply within 2 business hours during our opening times, 6am to 6pm Monday to Saturday. Call 0423 019 087 for the fastest answer, or use the form and we will come straight back to you.

props.label: Faq Local
props.html:
Local and specialty questions

Painting on the Lower North Shore: local FAQs

The area-specific questions: coverage, heritage, strata and harbourside surfaces.

Which North Sydney and Lower North Shore suburbs do you cover?
All 14 suburbs in the LGA: Cammeray, Cremorne, Cremorne Point, Crows Nest, Kirribilli, Kurraba Point, Lavender Bay, McMahons Point, Milsons Point, Neutral Bay, North Sydney, St Leonards, Waverton and Wollstonecraft.
Do you paint heritage and Federation homes?
Yes, it is a big part of what we do here. Most local streets sit inside a conservation area, so we prep original timber carefully, use heritage-appropriate colours, and work within council colour controls. We can point you to the council heritage pages if you need approval first.
Can you handle strata and apartment block painting?
Absolutely. We paint common areas, foyers, balconies and full unit-block exteriors, and we coordinate with your strata manager and committee from scope to sign-off. We work in staged zones so residents keep access throughout.
How do you protect harbourside exteriors from salt and weather?
Homes near the water take more salt, UV and wind-driven rain. We wash down, treat any mould, seal bare timber and render, then coat with a weather-shield system suited to the surface. Good prep is what makes a harbourside exterior last.
Do you do roof painting and pool painting?
Yes. We restore tile and metal roofs with a clean, repair, prime and membrane-coat process, and we repaint concrete pools in the correct chlorinated-rubber or epoxy system. Both are quoted fixed-price after an on-site look.
Can you paint offices and commercial spaces with minimal disruption?
We paint after-hours or in staged sections so your team keeps working. Low-odour products, safe access and clean daily pack-downs mean the space stays usable while we get it done.
Do you help with colour selection?
We do. We will talk through schemes that suit the home, the light and any heritage guidelines, and arrange sample pots so you can see colours on your own walls before we commit. Call 0423 019 087 to talk it through.

data.name: Sydney Paintmasters
data.description: Licensed and insured painting company serving North Sydney and the wider Lower North Shore for more than 20 years. House, interior, exterior, strata, commercial, roof and pool painting with fixed-price quotes and no call-out fee.

data.name: Bobby Nojad
data.description: Licensed painter (315254C) leading Sydney Paintmasters across North Sydney and the Lower North Shore for 20+ years.

mainEntity.name: How do I book a painter on the Lower North Shore?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call 0423 019 087 or send the quote form on this page. We arrange a free on-site visit, usually the same week, then give you a written fixed price. Once you accept, we lock in a start date that suits you.

mainEntity.name: Is your quote really free with no call-out fee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The on-site visit and the written quote are free, and there is no call-out fee at any stage. You only pay once you have accepted a fixed price and the work is booked in.

mainEntity.name: Are you licensed and insured?

acceptedAnswer.text: We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and carry full insurance. We are happy to show both before we start. Public liability cover can be confirmed on request for strata and commercial jobs.

mainEntity.name: Do you give a fixed price or an hourly rate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fixed price. Your quote is a written, line-item scope, so the number you accept is the number you pay. If you later add work, we price that separately and get your okay first.

mainEntity.name: What paint brands do you use?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use premium trade lines from the major Australian brands, matched to the surface and exposure. For harbourside exteriors we lean on proven weather-shield systems. Have a preferred brand or colour? Tell us and we will work to it.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical repaint take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A single interior room is often a day. A full home interior usually runs several days, and a house exterior depends on size, access and prep. We give you a realistic timeline in the quote, not a guess on the phone.

acceptedAnswer.text: We reply within 2 business hours during our opening times, 6am to 6pm Monday to Saturday. Call 0423 019 087 for the fastest answer, or use the form and we will come straight back to you.

props.label: Services
props.html:
What we paint

Painting services across the Lower North Shore

One licensed crew, nine core services. From a single feature wall to a full strata repaint, here is what we take on across the LGA.

House Painting Lower North Shore

Full-home repaints inside and out, from weatherboard cottages to double-brick family homes. We prep properly so the finish lasts.

Interior Painting Lower North Shore

Walls, ceilings, cornices, doors and trim. Low-odour paints, tidy cut-ins, and floors and furniture protected every day.

Exterior Painting Lower North Shore

Facades, eaves, render, timber and fibro built to cope with harbour salt, UV and wind-driven rain. Mould-treated before we prime.

Office Painting Lower North Shore

Workspaces refreshed around your hours. We paint after-hours or in staged zones so the team keeps working through it.

Strata Painting Lower North Shore

Common areas, foyers, balconies and unit-block exteriors. We coordinate with your strata manager and committee from quote to sign-off.

Commercial Painting Lower North Shore

Shops, hospitality venues and mixed-use sites. Durable coatings, safe access, and clean handovers that meet your open-by date.

Epoxy Flooring Lower North Shore

Hard-wearing epoxy for garages, warehouses and commercial floors. Sealed, slip-rated and easy to keep clean.

Pool Painting Lower North Shore

Concrete pool repaints in the right chlorinated-rubber or epoxy system, prepped and coated to hold up under water and sun.

Roof Painting Lower North Shore

Tile and metal roof restoration: clean, repair, prime and coat. A membrane system that lifts the whole street frontage.

We work the whole Lower North Shore. Here is the local detail we bring to each pocket, from harbourside heritage to the apartment strips.

Painting services in Neutral Bay2089

Neutral Bay is Military Road and Neutral Bay Junction out front, interwar Art Deco walk-ups behind. We repaint those rendered facades and shared stairwells, match original heritage tones, and work around body-corporate rules. The quiet Kurraba Point peninsula just off Neutral Bay is covered too.

Around the Willoughby Road dining strip, the Holtermann Estate is packed with Victorian and Federation terraces under conservation controls. We prep aged timber carefully, honour approved colour schemes, and keep small-lot sites tidy for the neighbours.

St Leonards runs to towers, medical suites near Royal North Shore, and new high-rise apartments. We paint tenancies and common areas out of hours, use low-odour systems, and stage the work so a busy commercial floor keeps running.

Get a Kirribilli quote →

Waverton is a quiet peninsula of Federation and Victorian cottages near Balls Head and Berrys Bay. We repaint timber fronts and iron roofs that face weather off the water, with prep built for a coating that holds.

Get a Waverton quote →

Cammeray sits around the Miller Street village, a mix of Federation homes, California bungalows and interwar flats. We refresh interiors and street frontages, and match the period detail that gives the suburb its character.

props.label: Process
props.html:
Simple from the start

Three steps, no surprises

We keep it short. You call, we quote, we paint. Here is how a job runs.

1

Free on-site quote

We visit, listen, measure and write a fixed line-item price. No call-out fee and no pressure. You will know exactly what is included.

2

Prep and paint

We protect the site, do the unglamorous prep first, then coat with quality paint. Same crew start to finish, tidy every afternoon.

3

Walk-through and done

We walk the job with you, fix any touch-ups on the spot, and clean up fully. You sign off only when you are happy.

props.label: Specialties
props.html:
What sets us apart

Three things we are known for

The LGA is not a blank canvas. Heritage rules, dense strata, and a harbour that eats exteriors. We build for all three.

Heritage

Federation and character homes

Across North Sydney, Neutral Bay, Cremorne and Waverton, most streets sit inside a conservation area. We handle careful timber prep, period detailing and heritage-appropriate colours, so a repaint respects the home and the guidelines.

Strata

Apartments, blocks and high-rise

The LGA is one of Sydney's densest apartment areas. We paint unit blocks, foyers, balconies and high-rise common property, coordinating with strata managers and committees so the whole building lands on one clear scope.

Coastal

Harbourside weather protection

Homes facing the water cop salt air, strong UV, wind-driven rain and shaded damp. We treat mould, seal bare surfaces and choose coating systems built to hold on timber, render, masonry and metal for the long haul.

All 14 suburbs in the LGA: Cammeray, Cremorne, Cremorne Point, Crows Nest, Kirribilli, Kurraba Point, Lavender Bay, McMahons Point, Milsons Point, Neutral Bay, North Sydney, St Leonards, Waverton and Wollstonecraft.

mainEntity.name: How do I book a painter on the Lower North Shore?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call 0423 019 087 or send the quote form on this page. We arrange a free on-site visit, usually the same week, then give you a written fixed price. Once you accept, we lock in a start date that suits you.

mainEntity.name: Is your quote really free with no call-out fee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The on-site visit and the written quote are free, and there is no call-out fee at any stage. You only pay once you have accepted a fixed price and the work is booked in.

mainEntity.name: Are you licensed and insured?

acceptedAnswer.text: We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and carry full insurance. We are happy to show both before we start. Public liability cover can be confirmed on request for strata and commercial jobs.

mainEntity.name: Do you give a fixed price or an hourly rate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fixed price. Your quote is a written, line-item scope, so the number you accept is the number you pay. If you later add work, we price that separately and get your okay first.

mainEntity.name: What paint brands do you use?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use premium trade lines from the major Australian brands, matched to the surface and exposure. For harbourside exteriors we lean on proven weather-shield systems. Have a preferred brand or colour? Tell us and we will work to it.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical repaint take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A single interior room is often a day. A full home interior usually runs several days, and a house exterior depends on size, access and prep. We give you a realistic timeline in the quote, not a guess on the phone.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will you reply to my enquiry?

acceptedAnswer.text: We reply within 2 business hours during our opening times, 6am to 6pm Monday to Saturday. Call 0423 019 087 for the fastest answer, or use the form and we will come straight back to you.

mainEntity.name: Which North Sydney and Lower North Shore suburbs do you cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: All 14 suburbs in the LGA: Cammeray, Cremorne, Cremorne Point, Crows Nest, Kirribilli, Kurraba Point, Lavender Bay, McMahons Point, Milsons Point, Neutral Bay, North Sydney, St Leonards, Waverton and Wollstonecraft.

mainEntity.name: Do you paint heritage and Federation homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is a big part of what we do here. Most local streets sit inside a conservation area, so we prep original timber carefully, use heritage-appropriate colours, and work within council colour controls. We can point you to the council heritage pages if you need approval first.

mainEntity.name: Can you handle strata and apartment block painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. We paint common areas, foyers, balconies and full unit-block exteriors, and we coordinate with your strata manager and committee from scope to sign-off. We work in staged zones so residents keep access throughout.

mainEntity.name: How do you protect harbourside exteriors from salt and weather?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homes near the water take more salt, UV and wind-driven rain. We wash down, treat any mould, seal bare timber and render, then coat with a weather-shield system suited to the surface. Good prep is what makes a harbourside exterior last.

mainEntity.name: Do you do roof painting and pool painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We restore tile and metal roofs with a clean, repair, prime and membrane-coat process, and we repaint concrete pools in the correct chlorinated-rubber or epoxy system. Both are quoted fixed-price after an on-site look.

mainEntity.name: Can you paint offices and commercial spaces with minimal disruption?

acceptedAnswer.text: We paint after-hours or in staged sections so your team keeps working. Low-odour products, safe access and clean daily pack-downs mean the space stays usable while we get it done.

mainEntity.name: Do you help with colour selection?

acceptedAnswer.text: We do. We will talk through schemes that suit the home, the light and any heritage guidelines, and arrange sample pots so you can see colours on your own walls before we commit. Call 0423 019 087 to talk it through.

props.label: Services
props.html:
What we paint

Painting services across the Lower North Shore

One licensed crew, nine core services. From a single feature wall to a full strata repaint, here is what we take on across the LGA.

House Painting Lower North Shore

Full-home repaints inside and out, from weatherboard cottages to double-brick family homes. We prep properly so the finish lasts.

Interior Painting Lower North Shore

Walls, ceilings, cornices, doors and trim. Low-odour paints, tidy cut-ins, and floors and furniture protected every day.

Exterior Painting Lower North Shore

Facades, eaves, render, timber and fibro built to cope with harbour salt, UV and wind-driven rain. Mould-treated before we prime.

Office Painting Lower North Shore

Workspaces refreshed around your hours. We paint after-hours or in staged zones so the team keeps working through it.

Strata Painting Lower North Shore

Common areas, foyers, balconies and unit-block exteriors. We coordinate with your strata manager and committee from quote to sign-off.

Commercial Painting Lower North Shore

Shops, hospitality venues and mixed-use sites. Durable coatings, safe access, and clean handovers that meet your open-by date.

Epoxy Flooring Lower North Shore

Hard-wearing epoxy for garages, warehouses and commercial floors. Sealed, slip-rated and easy to keep clean.

Pool Painting Lower North Shore

Concrete pool repaints in the right chlorinated-rubber or epoxy system, prepped and coated to hold up under water and sun.

Roof Painting Lower North Shore

Tile and metal roof restoration: clean, repair, prime and coat. A membrane system that lifts the whole street frontage.

We work the whole Lower North Shore. Here is the local detail we bring to each pocket, from harbourside heritage to the apartment strips.

Neutral Bay is Military Road and Neutral Bay Junction out front, interwar Art Deco walk-ups behind. We repaint those rendered facades and shared stairwells, match original heritage tones, and work around body-corporate rules. The quiet Kurraba Point peninsula just off Neutral Bay is covered too.

Get a Waverton quote →

McMahons Point runs down Blues Point Road to the water, Victorian and Federation cottages the whole way. We repaint steep harbourside timber and the small conservation-area frontages here. The tucked-away Lavender Bay pocket next door is covered too.

props.label: Process
props.html:
Simple from the start

Three steps, no surprises

We keep it short. You call, we quote, we paint. Here is how a job runs.

1

Free on-site quote

We visit, listen, measure and write a fixed line-item price. No call-out fee and no pressure. You will know exactly what is included.

2

Prep and paint

We protect the site, do the unglamorous prep first, then coat with quality paint. Same crew start to finish, tidy every afternoon.

3

Walk-through and done

We walk the job with you, fix any touch-ups on the spot, and clean up fully. You sign off only when you are happy.

props.label: Specialties
props.html:
What sets us apart

Three things we are known for

The LGA is not a blank canvas. Heritage rules, dense strata, and a harbour that eats exteriors. We build for all three.

Heritage

Federation and character homes

Across North Sydney, Neutral Bay, Cremorne and Waverton, most streets sit inside a conservation area. We handle careful timber prep, period detailing and heritage-appropriate colours, so a repaint respects the home and the guidelines.

Strata

Apartments, blocks and high-rise

The LGA is one of Sydney's densest apartment areas. We paint unit blocks, foyers, balconies and high-rise common property, coordinating with strata managers and committees so the whole building lands on one clear scope.

Coastal

Harbourside weather protection

Homes facing the water cop salt air, strong UV, wind-driven rain and shaded damp. We treat mould, seal bare surfaces and choose coating systems built to hold on timber, render, masonry and metal for the long haul.

mainEntity.name: How do I book a painter on the Lower North Shore?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call 0423 019 087 or send the quote form on this page. We arrange a free on-site visit, usually the same week, then give you a written fixed price. Once you accept, we lock in a start date that suits you.

mainEntity.name: Is your quote really free with no call-out fee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The on-site visit and the written quote are free, and there is no call-out fee at any stage. You only pay once you have accepted a fixed price and the work is booked in.

mainEntity.name: Are you licensed and insured?

acceptedAnswer.text: We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and carry full insurance. We are happy to show both before we start. Public liability cover can be confirmed on request for strata and commercial jobs.

mainEntity.name: Do you give a fixed price or an hourly rate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fixed price. Your quote is a written, line-item scope, so the number you accept is the number you pay. If you later add work, we price that separately and get your okay first.

mainEntity.name: What paint brands do you use?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use premium trade lines from the major Australian brands, matched to the surface and exposure. For harbourside exteriors we lean on proven weather-shield systems. Have a preferred brand or colour? Tell us and we will work to it.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical repaint take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A single interior room is often a day. A full home interior usually runs several days, and a house exterior depends on size, access and prep. We give you a realistic timeline in the quote, not a guess on the phone.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will you reply to my enquiry?

acceptedAnswer.text: We reply within 2 business hours during our opening times, 6am to 6pm Monday to Saturday. Call 0423 019 087 for the fastest answer, or use the form and we will come straight back to you.

mainEntity.name: Which North Sydney and Lower North Shore suburbs do you cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: All 14 suburbs in the LGA: Cammeray, Cremorne, Cremorne Point, Crows Nest, Kirribilli, Kurraba Point, Lavender Bay, McMahons Point, Milsons Point, Neutral Bay, North Sydney, St Leonards, Waverton and Wollstonecraft.

mainEntity.name: Do you paint heritage and Federation homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is a big part of what we do here. Most local streets sit inside a conservation area, so we prep original timber carefully, use heritage-appropriate colours, and work within council colour controls. We can point you to the council heritage pages if you need approval first.

mainEntity.name: Can you handle strata and apartment block painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. We paint common areas, foyers, balconies and full unit-block exteriors, and we coordinate with your strata manager and committee from scope to sign-off. We work in staged zones so residents keep access throughout.

mainEntity.name: How do you protect harbourside exteriors from salt and weather?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homes near the water take more salt, UV and wind-driven rain. We wash down, treat any mould, seal bare timber and render, then coat with a weather-shield system suited to the surface. Good prep is what makes a harbourside exterior last.

mainEntity.name: Do you do roof painting and pool painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We restore tile and metal roofs with a clean, repair, prime and membrane-coat process, and we repaint concrete pools in the correct chlorinated-rubber or epoxy system. Both are quoted fixed-price after an on-site look.

mainEntity.name: Can you paint offices and commercial spaces with minimal disruption?

acceptedAnswer.text: We paint after-hours or in staged sections so your team keeps working. Low-odour products, safe access and clean daily pack-downs mean the space stays usable while we get it done.

mainEntity.name: Do you help with colour selection?

acceptedAnswer.text: We do. We will talk through schemes that suit the home, the light and any heritage guidelines, and arrange sample pots so you can see colours on your own walls before we commit. Call 0423 019 087 to talk it through.

props.label: Services
props.html:
What we paint

Painting services across the Lower North Shore

One licensed crew, nine core services. From a single feature wall to a full strata repaint, here is what we take on across the LGA.

House Painting Lower North Shore

Full-home repaints inside and out, from weatherboard cottages to double-brick family homes. We prep properly so the finish lasts.

Interior Painting Lower North Shore

Walls, ceilings, cornices, doors and trim. Low-odour paints, tidy cut-ins, and floors and furniture protected every day.

Exterior Painting Lower North Shore

Facades, eaves, render, timber and fibro built to cope with harbour salt, UV and wind-driven rain. Mould-treated before we prime.

Office Painting Lower North Shore

Workspaces refreshed around your hours. We paint after-hours or in staged zones so the team keeps working through it.

Strata Painting Lower North Shore

Common areas, foyers, balconies and unit-block exteriors. We coordinate with your strata manager and committee from quote to sign-off.

Commercial Painting Lower North Shore

Shops, hospitality venues and mixed-use sites. Durable coatings, safe access, and clean handovers that meet your open-by date.

Epoxy Flooring Lower North Shore

Hard-wearing epoxy for garages, warehouses and commercial floors. Sealed, slip-rated and easy to keep clean.

Pool Painting Lower North Shore

Concrete pool repaints in the right chlorinated-rubber or epoxy system, prepped and coated to hold up under water and sun.

Roof Painting Lower North Shore

Tile and metal roof restoration: clean, repair, prime and coat. A membrane system that lifts the whole street frontage.

Neutral Bay is Military Road and Neutral Bay Junction out front, interwar Art Deco walk-ups behind. We repaint those rendered facades and shared stairwells, match original heritage tones, and work around body-corporate rules. The quiet Kurraba Point peninsula just off Neutral Bay is covered too.

props.label: Process
props.html:
Simple from the start

Three steps, no surprises

We keep it short. You call, we quote, we paint. Here is how a job runs.

1

Free on-site quote

We visit, listen, measure and write a fixed line-item price. No call-out fee and no pressure. You will know exactly what is included.

2

Prep and paint

We protect the site, do the unglamorous prep first, then coat with quality paint. Same crew start to finish, tidy every afternoon.

3

Walk-through and done

We walk the job with you, fix any touch-ups on the spot, and clean up fully. You sign off only when you are happy.

props.label: Specialties
props.html:
What sets us apart

Three things we are known for

The LGA is not a blank canvas. Heritage rules, dense strata, and a harbour that eats exteriors. We build for all three.

Heritage

Federation and character homes

Across North Sydney, Neutral Bay, Cremorne and Waverton, most streets sit inside a conservation area. We handle careful timber prep, period detailing and heritage-appropriate colours, so a repaint respects the home and the guidelines.

Strata

Apartments, blocks and high-rise

The LGA is one of Sydney's densest apartment areas. We paint unit blocks, foyers, balconies and high-rise common property, coordinating with strata managers and committees so the whole building lands on one clear scope.

Coastal

Harbourside weather protection

Homes facing the water cop salt air, strong UV, wind-driven rain and shaded damp. We treat mould, seal bare surfaces and choose coating systems built to hold on timber, render, masonry and metal for the long haul.

mainEntity.name: How do I book a painter on the Lower North Shore?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call 0423 019 087 or send the quote form on this page. We arrange a free on-site visit, usually the same week, then give you a written fixed price. Once you accept, we lock in a start date that suits you.

mainEntity.name: Is your quote really free with no call-out fee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The on-site visit and the written quote are free, and there is no call-out fee at any stage. You only pay once you have accepted a fixed price and the work is booked in.

mainEntity.name: Are you licensed and insured?

acceptedAnswer.text: We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and carry full insurance. We are happy to show both before we start. Public liability cover can be confirmed on request for strata and commercial jobs.

mainEntity.name: Do you give a fixed price or an hourly rate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fixed price. Your quote is a written, line-item scope, so the number you accept is the number you pay. If you later add work, we price that separately and get your okay first.

mainEntity.name: What paint brands do you use?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use premium trade lines from the major Australian brands, matched to the surface and exposure. For harbourside exteriors we lean on proven weather-shield systems. Have a preferred brand or colour? Tell us and we will work to it.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical repaint take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A single interior room is often a day. A full home interior usually runs several days, and a house exterior depends on size, access and prep. We give you a realistic timeline in the quote, not a guess on the phone.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will you reply to my enquiry?

acceptedAnswer.text: We reply within 2 business hours during our opening times, 6am to 6pm Monday to Saturday. Call 0423 019 087 for the fastest answer, or use the form and we will come straight back to you.

mainEntity.name: Which North Sydney and Lower North Shore suburbs do you cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: All 14 suburbs in the LGA: Cammeray, Cremorne, Cremorne Point, Crows Nest, Kirribilli, Kurraba Point, Lavender Bay, McMahons Point, Milsons Point, Neutral Bay, North Sydney, St Leonards, Waverton and Wollstonecraft.

mainEntity.name: Do you paint heritage and Federation homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is a big part of what we do here. Most local streets sit inside a conservation area, so we prep original timber carefully, use heritage-appropriate colours, and work within council colour controls. We can point you to the council heritage pages if you need approval first.

mainEntity.name: Can you handle strata and apartment block painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. We paint common areas, foyers, balconies and full unit-block exteriors, and we coordinate with your strata manager and committee from scope to sign-off. We work in staged zones so residents keep access throughout.

mainEntity.name: How do you protect harbourside exteriors from salt and weather?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homes near the water take more salt, UV and wind-driven rain. We wash down, treat any mould, seal bare timber and render, then coat with a weather-shield system suited to the surface. Good prep is what makes a harbourside exterior last.

mainEntity.name: Do you do roof painting and pool painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We restore tile and metal roofs with a clean, repair, prime and membrane-coat process, and we repaint concrete pools in the correct chlorinated-rubber or epoxy system. Both are quoted fixed-price after an on-site look.

mainEntity.name: Can you paint offices and commercial spaces with minimal disruption?

acceptedAnswer.text: We paint after-hours or in staged sections so your team keeps working. Low-odour products, safe access and clean daily pack-downs mean the space stays usable while we get it done.

mainEntity.name: Do you help with colour selection?

acceptedAnswer.text: We do. We will talk through schemes that suit the home, the light and any heritage guidelines, and arrange sample pots so you can see colours on your own walls before we commit. Call 0423 019 087 to talk it through.

Simple from the start

Three steps, no surprises

We keep it short. You call, we quote, we paint. Here is how a job runs.

1

Free on-site quote

We visit, listen, measure and write a fixed line-item price. No call-out fee and no pressure. You will know exactly what is included.

2

Prep and paint

We protect the site, do the unglamorous prep first, then coat with quality paint. Same crew start to finish, tidy every afternoon.

Walk-through and done

We walk the job with you, fix any touch-ups on the spot, and clean up fully. You sign off only when you are happy.

Three things we are known for

The LGA is not a blank canvas. Heritage rules, dense strata, and a harbour that eats exteriors. We build for all three.

Federation and character homes

Harbourside weather protection

Homes facing the water cop salt air, strong UV, wind-driven rain and shaded damp. We treat mould, seal bare surfaces and choose coating systems built to hold on timber, render, masonry and metal for the long haul.

Local and specialty questions

Painting on the Lower North Shore: local FAQs

The area-specific questions: coverage, heritage, strata and harbourside surfaces.

Which North Sydney and Lower North Shore suburbs do you cover?
All 14 suburbs in the LGA: Cammeray, Cremorne, Cremorne Point, Crows Nest, Kirribilli, Kurraba Point, Lavender Bay, McMahons Point, Milsons Point, Neutral Bay, North Sydney, St Leonards, Waverton and Wollstonecraft.
Do you paint heritage and Federation homes?
Yes, it is a big part of what we do here. Most local streets sit inside a conservation area, so we prep original timber carefully, use heritage-appropriate colours, and work within council colour controls. We can point you to the council heritage pages if you need approval first.
Can you handle strata and apartment block painting?
Absolutely. We paint common areas, foyers, balconies and full unit-block exteriors, and we coordinate with your strata manager and committee from scope to sign-off. We work in staged zones so residents keep access throughout.
How do you protect harbourside exteriors from salt and weather?
Homes near the water take more salt, UV and wind-driven rain. We wash down, treat any mould, seal bare timber and render, then coat with a weather-shield system suited to the surface. Good prep is what makes a harbourside exterior last.
Do you do roof painting and pool painting?
Yes. We restore tile and metal roofs with a clean, repair, prime and membrane-coat process, and we repaint concrete pools in the correct chlorinated-rubber or epoxy system. Both are quoted fixed-price after an on-site look.
Can you paint offices and commercial spaces with minimal disruption?
We paint after-hours or in staged sections so your team keeps working. Low-odour products, safe access and clean daily pack-downs mean the space stays usable while we get it done.
Do you help with colour selection?
We do. We will talk through schemes that suit the home, the light and any heritage guidelines, and arrange sample pots so you can see colours on your own walls before we commit. Call 0423 019 087 to talk it through.

.mobile-submenu a{padding-left:40px;font-size:.94rem;font-weight:600}
.mobile-submenu[hidden]{display:none}
header .nav>ul>li:hover>ul{opacity:1!important;visibility:visible!important;transform:translateY(0)!important}

/* clone-only: quote popup */
.spm-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;display:none}
.spm-modal.open{display:block}
.spm-modal__backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(28,41,63,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;transition:opacity .22s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__backdrop{opacity:1}
.spm-modal__scroll{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:24px 16px 40px}
.spm-modal__dialog{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:520px;margin:auto;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.98);opacity:0;transition:transform .24s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1),opacity .24s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__dialog{transform:none;opacity:1}
.spm-modal__dialog>div{max-width:none!important;width:100%}
.spm-modal__dialog h2,.spm-modal__dialog h3{padding-right:46px}
.spm-modal__close{position:absolute;top:18px;right:18px;z-index:3;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:var(--light,#f0f0fa);color:var(--navy,#1c293f);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .18s ease,color .18s ease,transform .18s ease}
.spm-modal__close:hover{background:var(--primary,#016edc);color:#fff;transform:rotate(90deg)}
.spm-modal__close:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#ffa800);outline-offset:2px}
@media(max-width:520px){.spm-modal__close{top:14px;right:14px;width:32px;height:32px}.spm-modal__dialog h2,.spm-modal__dialog h3{padding-right:40px}}
body.spm-modal-open{overflow:hidden}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.spm-modal__backdrop,.spm-modal__dialog{transition:none}}

data.name: Sydney Paintmasters
data.description: Licensed and insured painting company serving North Sydney and the wider Lower North Shore for more than 20 years. House, interior, exterior, strata, commercial, roof and pool painting with fixed-price quotes and no call-out fee.

data.name: Bobby Nojad
data.description: Licensed painter (315254C) leading Sydney Paintmasters across North Sydney and the Lower North Shore for 20+ years.

mainEntity.name: How do I book a painter on the Lower North Shore?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call 0423 019 087 or send the quote form on this page. We arrange a free on-site visit, usually the same week, then give you a written fixed price. Once you accept, we lock in a start date that suits you.

mainEntity.name: Is your quote really free with no call-out fee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The on-site visit and the written quote are free, and there is no call-out fee at any stage. You only pay once you have accepted a fixed price and the work is booked in.

mainEntity.name: Are you licensed and insured?

acceptedAnswer.text: We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and carry full insurance. We are happy to show both before we start. Public liability cover can be confirmed on request for strata and commercial jobs.

mainEntity.name: Do you give a fixed price or an hourly rate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fixed price. Your quote is a written, line-item scope, so the number you accept is the number you pay. If you later add work, we price that separately and get your okay first.

mainEntity.name: What paint brands do you use?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use premium trade lines from the major Australian brands, matched to the surface and exposure. For harbourside exteriors we lean on proven weather-shield systems. Have a preferred brand or colour? Tell us and we will work to it.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical repaint take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A single interior room is often a day. A full home interior usually runs several days, and a house exterior depends on size, access and prep. We give you a realistic timeline in the quote, not a guess on the phone.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will you reply to my enquiry?

acceptedAnswer.text: We reply within 2 business hours during our opening times, 6am to 6pm Monday to Saturday. Call 0423 019 087 for the fastest answer, or use the form and we will come straight back to you.

mainEntity.name: Which North Sydney and Lower North Shore suburbs do you cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: All 14 suburbs in the LGA: Cammeray, Cremorne, Cremorne Point, Crows Nest, Kirribilli, Kurraba Point, Lavender Bay, McMahons Point, Milsons Point, Neutral Bay, North Sydney, St Leonards, Waverton and Wollstonecraft.

mainEntity.name: Do you paint heritage and Federation homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is a big part of what we do here. Most local streets sit inside a conservation area, so we prep original timber carefully, use heritage-appropriate colours, and work within council colour controls. We can point you to the council heritage pages if you need approval first.

mainEntity.name: Can you handle strata and apartment block painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. We paint common areas, foyers, balconies and full unit-block exteriors, and we coordinate with your strata manager and committee from scope to sign-off. We work in staged zones so residents keep access throughout.

mainEntity.name: How do you protect harbourside exteriors from salt and weather?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homes near the water take more salt, UV and wind-driven rain. We wash down, treat any mould, seal bare timber and render, then coat with a weather-shield system suited to the surface. Good prep is what makes a harbourside exterior last.

mainEntity.name: Do you do roof painting and pool painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We restore tile and metal roofs with a clean, repair, prime and membrane-coat process, and we repaint concrete pools in the correct chlorinated-rubber or epoxy system. Both are quoted fixed-price after an on-site look.

mainEntity.name: Can you paint offices and commercial spaces with minimal disruption?

acceptedAnswer.text: We paint after-hours or in staged sections so your team keeps working. Low-odour products, safe access and clean daily pack-downs mean the space stays usable while we get it done.

mainEntity.name: Do you help with colour selection?

acceptedAnswer.text: We do. We will talk through schemes that suit the home, the light and any heritage guidelines, and arrange sample pots so you can see colours on your own walls before we commit. Call 0423 019 087 to talk it through.
